title: HackathonPRDTemplate
description: Product Requirements Document specification filled during the Forge idea phase

problem_statement.description: Clear 2-3 sentence statement of the hackathon challenge being solved

target_vertical.description: Filename identifier matching verticals/<target_vertical>.json (e.g. agriculture, healthcare, logistics)

primary_persona.description: Primary end-user consuming recommendations (e.g., Smallholder Farmer, Triage Nurse, Operations Manager)

core_entities.description: Crucial variables the Understand stage must extract (e.g., ['crop_type', 'soil_moisture', 'region', 'symptoms'])

grounding_data_source.description: Description and location of tabular/CSV dataset placed in data/ for the Analyze stage

prediction_targets.description: Quantifiable projections generated in Predict stage (e.g., ['yield_loss_risk_percentage', 'recovery_window_days'])

key_risk_indicators.description: Critical thresholds monitored by Detect Risk stage

desired_recommendations.description: Classes of actionable guidance produced by Recommend stage

watsonx_granite_role.description: Specific reasoning responsibilities delegated to IBM Granite model

evaluation_metrics.description: Hackathon judging criteria addressed (e.g. Accuracy, Latency, Actionability, Social Impact)
